Right Column: Visitor profile song player card (vinyl animation + play/pause/mute), About Me section, Who I'd like to meet section, Custom text/HTML blocks, Top 8 friends grid with avatar thumbnails and status indicators, Content tabs (Favorites, Lyrics, Playlists, Stats)
Layout switcher: Left Info / Right Info / Centered Single Column
Mobile view (<640px): Stacked responsive view with sticky avatar header

myspace_style_editor.desktop_ui: Right-side floating glass drawer (420px wide) with live background preview
myspace_style_editor.mobile_ui: Bottom sheet modal with drag handle
editor_tabs: Background (Colors, Gradients, Cover Images, Custom Patterns)
Cards (Style: Glass/Solid/Outline/Neon/Paper, Opacity slider, Blur strength, Border Radius)
Text & Fonts (Google Font selectors for Headings & Body, Text/Link/Accent/Heading pickers)
Song & Mood (Select Treesh profile song, autoplay toggle, custom mood badge & note)
Sections (Toggle visibility & drag-reorder About Me, Who I'd Like To Meet, Free Text Blocks 1-6, Top 8 Friends)
Layout (Left info column / Right info column / Center stack)

sections: Transport Header: Play/Pause/Stop, BPM slider, Tap Tempo, Metronome toggle, Loop range toggle, Master Volume, Record Arm, Export WAV button
Pattern Bank & Song Arranger Strip: Chain synth & beat patterns (A/B/C/D) into song structure timelines
Unified Track Manager: Integrates Beat Drum Lanes (Step Sequencer 16/32 steps) and Vocal/Audio Waveform Tracks in a single track tree
Channel Strip: Per-track Gain, Pan slider, Mute/Solo buttons, Reverb send slider, Echo/Delay send slider, Track Color selector
Master Metering: Stereo LED VU meter display (peak & RMS visualization)

components: Search Hero with live instant filtering across features
Desktop Left Rail sticky Table of Contents with smooth scroll section targeting
Feature Grid by Category (Library, Now Playing, Lyrics, Studios, Games, Profiles, Accounts, Privacy)
Interactive FAQ Accordion with search auto-expand

Support Contact Form: Name, Email, Topic Chips (Bug, Feature, Billing, Account), Message textarea. FormSubmit.co action to support@treesh.app with interactive status handlers (loading, success banner, error fallback)

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic outputs. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g., transition: all). Exclude transforms.
You MUST NOT center align the app container (.App text-align: center is forbidden).
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters (🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯) for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations: hover states, transitions, entrance animations.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute.
